newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices seen drifting down after US dip.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices seen drifting down after US dip.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened marginally lower on Monday and dealers predicted that they would trickle down undramatically during the course of the day in a jittery market hit by Friday's Wall Street declines.
"We seem to be more or less holding our level but prices are expected to drift down moderately," one dealer warned.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was 0.03 point down from Friday's close at 108.67 at 0730 gmt. The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 71 basis points. The crown was slightly lower at 3.8090 per mark. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
